posts.title: Should the city make public transit free for students?
posts.text: Several cities now offer free or reduced transit passes to students, paid for through fees or the city budget. Supporters say it lowers the cost of getting to class and work, and takes cars off crowded streets. Critics say the money would do more good spent on more frequent and reliable service for everyone.
